setup.command: command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && pkg-config --exists openssl 2>/dev/null && pkg-config --exists alsa 2>/dev/null && command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cargo rustc pkg-config libssl-dev libasound2-dev git-lfs && rustup component add rustfmt)
